language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot lifts and transports the spoon toward the open drawer (frames 80–178, image, left_ego_image and wrist_image), but the spoon falls outside the drawer onto the tabletop (frames 182–191, image and left_ego_image). At frame 230 it remains on the table, establishing a visibly failed placement rather than merely unconfirmed completion.

failure_annotations.explanation: After carrying the spoon to the drawer, the robot loses or releases it outside the drawer: it moves downward out of the gripper at frames 182–184 in wrist_image and left_ego_image, falls onto the table at frames 185–187, and settles there by frame 191 in image and left_ego_image. This defeats the intended placement; the images do not establish whether the release was intentional or a slip.
failure_annotations.recovery: Reacquire the spoon from the tabletop, verify a secure hold, and position it fully over the drawer interior before lowering and releasing it; no human intervention appears necessary.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The spoon lands on the tabletop and remains visibly intact; no damage or disturbance to unrelated objects is apparent.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The spoon remains accessible on the table and the drawer remains open, allowing another attempt without environmental resetting or human intervention.
